turns.prompt: Build a small local playable motion study of a docked card emerging from a slot. The card must remain visibly connected to its own docking edge and retain a consistent material and silhouette in both retracted and expanded states. Show two timing approaches A and B using the same geometry: one softly buoyant, one deliberately controlled. Include hover and keyboard focus. Deliver index.html with any local files, actual browser a-retracted.png, a-expanded.png, b-retracted.png, b-expanded.png and notes.md; show intermediate motion evidence, not only endpoints. Keep trigger text readable throughout and report what was actually played.

Choose A only for its continuity and restrained speed. Keep B as it was. Remove bounce at the end without introducing a pause between the transition and the slow idle material drift. Preserve the attachment, geometry and text hierarchy. Show actual intermediate and endpoint browser evidence, and explain the continuity relation rather than calling it natural without evidence.

If a second selection arrives halfway through emergence, retarget from the current position. Only the selected card should emerge; the others stay docked. Retracting must end at the same docking geometry, not a separate rectangle that suddenly replaces the card. Include a reduced-motion path that conveys the same selected ownership without spatial travel. Exercise those states and distinguish actual playback from proposals.
